basic_profile.bio: A passionate PC builder and tech enthusiast living in Austin, Texas. I work as a software engineer for a gaming company, which keeps me busy during the day. In my free time, I love diving into the world of custom PC builds and sharing my experiences with others. I'm single and enjoy late-night gaming sessions and discussions about the latest tech trends. My typical online hours are from 8 PM to midnight CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Over the years, I have gained extensive knowledge in computer hardware and building custom PCs. My expertise comes from a combination of formal education in computer science, hands-on experience, and countless hours spent on forums and YouTube channels dedicated to tech. I also keep up-to-date with the latest advancements in technology through industry news and discussions.
